_readme: Fill in country of origin the automatic inference misses. `brands` maps a lowercased brand name to a country (applies to every product of that brand); `slugs` maps a single product slug to a country and wins over everything. After editing, run: node scripts/build-catalog.mjs && npm run db:seed. Use country names exactly as in COUNTRY_FLAGS (e.g. "Morocco", "Saudi Arabia", "United Arab Emirates").
